{{Top|leg}}
'''Gene therapy''' was the use of [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] as a pharmaceutical agent to treat disease and could also be used to supplement and alter genes. [[Zsinj]] had ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Tuzin Gast]] and his subordinates, to use genetic and chemical therapies to increase the intellect and [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like qualities of [[Species/Legends|species]] such as the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]].
